## Overview

**Hjalvar Skallfang** — the son of Hrothgar Skallfang and the current leader of the Skallfang Clan. He grew up alongside Balor in Ulfrheim, and throughout their childhood the two became the closest thing either would have to brothers. When Hrothgar died during the attack on Ulfrheim, Hjalvar inherited the mantle of Chieftain of the Skallfang.

---

## Relationship with Balor

Hjalvar grew up alongside Balor in Ulfrheim. They trained together, hunted together, fought alongside one another, and constantly competed to see who could become the stronger warrior. Their rivalry was never born from hatred — it was built on mutual respect.

Hjalvar knew Balor better than almost anyone. He understood his temper, his strengths, and his weaknesses, and was one of the few people capable of standing against him in training without fear. Balor, in turn, respected Hjalvar not only as a warrior, but as someone who could challenge him without ever trying to diminish him.

Where Balor's path was increasingly shaped by the strange power within him, Hjalvar remained deeply connected to the teachings of his father and the traditions of the Skallfang. When Hrothgar died during the attack on Ulfrheim, Hjalvar inherited the mantle of Chieftain of the Skallfang.

His father's death and Balor's first wielding of Khar'Zul became inseparable memories for him — the night his father died, his home was destroyed, and the brother he had grown up with walked away carrying a power none of them understood.

---

## Current Status

Despite everything that happened that night, Hjalvar never came to see Balor as an enemy. Their paths simply became different. As Chief, Hjalvar carries the responsibility of protecting the Skallfang and preserving everything his father spent his life building. And somewhere within him remains the same young warrior who once stood beside Balor, competing with him beneath the northern sky.
